artifact.summary: Trotterized two-fermion (any fixed particle number) non-interacting continuous-time quantum walk exp(-i t A) in second quantization on a user-supplied graph. Each vertex is one qubit (one-hot occupation). Hopping terms use Jordan-Wigner Z-strings, so the Hamming-weight-2 sector reproduces the antisymmetric two-fermion subspace generated by A^(2). G4/G5/T4/T5 are not hardcoded. The graph is an instance parameter.
register_layout: qubit k (0..N-1), k = vertex k occupation, one-hot; qubit 0 is least significant
antisymmetric two-fermion state |i,j>_- (i<j) corresponds to the computational basis state with qubits i and j equal to 1 (Hamming weight 2); the runner prepares inputs
no ancilla qubits; total qubits = num_vertices <= 12

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit register layout (one-hot occupation, weight-2 sector)
equation_mapping.explanation: The antisymmetric basis |i,j>_- is represented by occupation-number states with qubits i<j set. The circuit does not prepare it and it is chosen by the runner.

Second-quantized hopping H=sum a_i^dag a_j + h.c. with Jordan-Wigner strings. In the two-particle sector it equals A tensor I + I tensor A restricted to the antisymmetric subspace. Evolution is a first-order Trotter product over edges.

This is a classical comparison criterion on matrices or derived walk observables. The circuit supplies the walk evolution for any graph and performs no comparison. The spec's spectral clause fails for non-interacting fermions.
The harmonic-oscillator network Hamiltonian is a continuous-variable model and is not encoded in this qubit circuit. Its coupling form was also only assumed.
The Gaussian-state entanglement entropy formula is classical postprocessing of covariance matrices and is not a circuit operation.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to the walk dynamics: a Trotterized exp(-itA) in one-hot Jordan-Wigner encoding on N qubits instead of an explicit N(N-1)/2-dimensional antisymmetric-space unitary. The walker number is set by the runner's input Hamming weight, not fixed at two.
specification_changes.reason: The spec gives no circuit encoding, and a dense unitary on the antisymmetric subspace is not allowed. The second-quantized form is equivalent on the antisymmetric subspace.

specification_changes.change: The evolution is approximate (first-order Trotter, user-chosen number of steps) rather than exact exp(-itA^(2)).
specification_changes.reason: Edge hopping terms do not commute in general, and no exact decomposition is available with standard gates.

specification_changes.change: The distinguishing criterion, oscillator model, and entropy are not implemented. No G4/G5/T4/T5 adjacency is built in.
specification_changes.reason: They are classical, continuous-variable or analytic, and the abstract does not give the explicit graphs.

assumptions: Unit hopping amplitude per edge with unweighted, undirected simple graphs
Vertex ordering fixes the Jordan-Wigner string, and edges are applied in sorted order
Input states with fixed Hamming weight (e.g. 2) are supplied by the runner
unresolved_issues: Explicit adjacency of G4(n;n+2), G5(n;n+2), T4, T5 is not given in the abstract and must be supplied as an instance
Exactness is limited by the Trotter step count
Entanglement-entropy part of the paper is not realized in the circuit

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
